svg.aria-label: Reading a big file. Without justless, cat docs/reference.md prints all 1,142 lines (273,594 bytes). With justless, justless read docs/reference.md --outline returns 43 lines (1,598 bytes) using compact h1, h2, h3, table and code anchors. justless expand docs/reference.md '5ed9fdb08d39e4ae9bf0c355#35' then returns the Failures section, lines 781 to 784, byte for byte (794 bytes). The outline is 171× smaller than the file.

g.text: # Justless reference
## Commands
| Command | Result |
| `justless run --max-bytes 4096 -- COMMAND ARG…` |
Bounded previews for stdout and stderr, the child exit
status (127 or 126 when the command cannot be found or
run), and the run ID. Without `--max-bytes`, each
command family's budget adapts to how often agents
replayed its clipped streams in full. |
| `justless exec --lang python3 --file data.json CODE` |
Runs a short script and returns only what it prints,
with its exit status. The full output keeps a run ID.
The code can also come from stdin (`-`) or `--script
FILE`. |
| `justless exec … --intent TEXT` | Replaces stdout longer
than the preview with the lines most relevant to TEXT,
each marked for `justless log` |
| `justless search RUN_ID TEXT` | Literal matches with
stream and line numbers, up to `--limit`, 20 by default.
When the limit cuts, every stream with a match keeps a
place, a failed run's failure lines and stderr come
first, and a last line counts what each stream left out.
| `justless log RUN_ID --stream stdout --from 10 --to 15`
| Original bytes for the specified inclusive line range,
with secrets replaced by markers. `--unredacted` returns
the exact bytes. Omit the range to replay the complete
stream. |
… 769 more lines
### Failures
A body the proxy cannot parse or plan is forwarded
unchanged, and so is a body over 64 MiB, streamed with
its declared length. A body that ends before its
`Content-Length`, or a malformed chunked body, is
answered with a 400 and never forwarded. `--upstream`
and `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` cannot carry credentials in the
URL, because the proxy prints and logs it. When the API
rejects the clearing edit itself with a 400 or 422 that
names it, the proxy sends the original request once
more, relays that response, and leaves the edit off for
that model until it restarts. Every other response,
errors included, is relayed unchanged and never retried.
An unreachable upstream returns a 502 with an error in
the API's format. Compressed responses are relayed but
not counted in `stats`.

### Failures
A body the proxy cannot parse or plan is forwarded unchanged,
and so is a body over 64 MiB, streamed with its declared
length. A body that ends before its `Content-Length`, or a
malformed chunked body, is answered with a 400 and never
forwarded. `--upstream` and `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` cannot
carry credentials in the URL, because the proxy prints and
logs it. When the API rejects the clearing edit itself with
a 400 or 422 that names it, the proxy sends the original
request once more, relays that response, and leaves the edit
off for that model until it restarts. Every other response,
errors included, is relayed unchanged and never retried. An
unreachable upstream returns a 502 with an error in the
API's format. Compressed responses are relayed but not
counted in `stats`.
